title: Install identity
description: The one document that names this install. Records made here carry its install_id (product rule 14).

install_id.description: This install's UUID (lower case, version 4), made once when the install is set up.

ids_required.description: true: every record must carry global_id and install_id. false only while a migration adds them (stella_data.py ids-migrate, then stella-apply.py apply), so each step can be rolled back.
